text:
I evaluated #Jev from @typesafeai against  @Google  #Gemini 3.8 flash

Jev decides sentiment, topic, "bug?" and churn risk for 1,000 real app reviews, racing Gemini 3.8 Flash on the same job.  

Jev: 4.6s, $0.023. 
Gemini: 18.8s, $0.158.  

Git repo → https://github.com/goodrahstar/jev-column-race
